Key Points

    • The past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (broke) + Object' will be changed into the past perfect tense format 'Subject + had + V3 (broken) + Object'.

Correct sentence:  'Peter said that he had broken his glasses.'

questions.question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence. Roopa said to me, "Please accompany me to the market."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Roopa requested me to accompany her to the market.'

Key Points

  • The given direct speech is an imperative sentence. An imperative sentence is a sentence that expresses a command, a request, advice, or a suggestion.
    • Open the door. (Command)
    • Please help me. (Request)
    • Quit smoking. (Advice.)
  • As imperative sentences have a command, a request, advice, or a suggestion, to change them into an indirect speech some specific verbs are used (requested, order, advised, forbade, suggested) to replace the verbs (e.g. told, said) of reporting verb.
  • In the given sentence, 'please' is used which gives the tone of requesting somebody. Hence, use 'requested' in the reported speech.


So the correct Indirect speech is→ Roopa requested me to accompany her to the market.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Raj requested his friend to help him in that task.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is a direct speech.
  • The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
    • The commas, inverted commas are removed.
    • 'Please' indicates a request and therefore, the reporting verb 'requested' should be used in place of 'please' and it must be followed by an object.
    • Requests are usually reported using a to-infinitive (here, to help).
    • The first-person pronoun 'me' becomes the third-person pronoun 'him' and the 'this' becomes 'that'.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Hinglish

  • दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
  • Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
    • Commas, inverted commas और exclamation mark हटा दिए जाते हैं।
    • 'Please' एक अनुरोध को इंगित करता है और इसलिए, 'Please' के स्थान पर रिपोर्टिंग क्रिया 'requested' का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
    • Requests को आमतौर पर to-infinitive (यहां, to help) का उपयोग करके रिपोर्ट किया जाता है।
    • First-person pronoun 'me', third-person pronoun 'him' बन जाता है और 'this', 'that' बन जाता है।
       

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।
